messages:
mia (product): Quick check — proposing a "degrade ladder" for EU Dedicated pacing: green/yellow/red -> ladder steps before cross-region. Thoughts?
raj (eng-sre): +1. Define minute granularity counters, 1h rolling window. Trigger fallback if red for 2x5m windows.
jules (eng-platform): We'll shard counters and add per-tenant ladder_level. Rollout: internal canary -> 2% -> 10% -> 100%.
lina (eng-runtime): Runtime supports variant routing; need dry-run mode and idempotent set_ladder_level API. Avoid KV hot keys by sharding.
sam (sales): Customers want visibility + emergency purchase option. We'll surface remaining budget and opt-in UI copy.
ops-oncall: Add circuit-breaker: if p95 +200ms or error +1% for 5m after change, auto-revert and page SRE. Also add notifications for yellow/red.
mia (product): Launch Criteria: policy engine in staging, UI opt-in + consent logs, telemetry gates, legal signoff for cross-region. Owners: jules/lina API spec, raj staging tests, sam customer copy. Sync tomorrow 10:30.
